title: 上海高考翻译背诵-62-26一模普陀

items.zh: 对你的乘客而言，超速不仅是非常危险的，而且也是违反法律的。
items.en: Speeding is not only extremely dangerous for your passengers but also against the law.

items.zh: 通过这部纪录片，导演成功地向观众传递了保护濒危物种的重要性。
items.en: Through the documentary, the director succeeded in communicating the importance of protecting endangered species to the audience.

items.zh: 这位软件工程师每每遇到问题时都会向团队救助，这足以说明团队协作的核心价值。
items.en: Every time the software engineer encounters problems, he turns to his team for assistance, which clearly demonstrates the core value of teamwork.

items.zh: 这位餐厅经理坚持认为，只有当公众真正了解海草并愿意接受它作为食物来源时，规模化生产才有意义。
items.en: The restaurant manager insists that only when the public truly understands seaweed and accepts it as a food source, does its large-scale production make sense.
